integrity: Finite exact-rational branch enumeration with independently checked edge solutions, an explicit singular-branch analysis, and executable bundled checker. No infinite-period claim.
scientific_limitations: The classification applies only to the symmetric slope-two orthogonal tents map; no higher-period or perturbed-parameter census is claimed. Switching cycles have no ordinary smooth monodromy trace. Priority is qualified by unindexed literature. Independent audit not performed.
title: Eighty primitive four-cycles in the orthogonal tents map
